headline: Ludhiana records 1 fire detection with PM2.5 forecast expected tomorrow
briefing: On 2025-11-22, Ludhiana district recorded 1 fire detection and ranked 3 among Punjab's districts, while Punjab total reached 8. The total fire radiative power was 2.2 MW. Satellite fire detections represent a lower bound due to potential cloud cover, missed fires, or overpass timing [K101]. Winds blew from the WNW at 3.8 km/h, and upwind fire activity showed an upwind pressure score of 27.0. For the nearest monitored city, Ludhiana, today's PM2.5 level was 158.8 ug/m3. The next-day PM2.5 forecast is 130.3 ug/m3, with an 80% uncertainty interval ranging from a p10 of 102.7 ug/m3 to a p90 of 170.6 ug/m3. CAMS models PM2.5 on a coarse grid rather than providing street-level measurements [K035]. Model reliability testing shows an 80% interval coverage of 87.7% across test seasons.

# Ludhiana: fire detections, season 2024

In the 2024 season (Sep 15 to Nov 30), satellite fire detection (VIIRS S-NPP) recorded 339 fire detections in Ludhiana district, with a total fire radiative power of 1,428 MW. Among the 22 districts it ranked number 12 by detections.

The busiest day was 2024-11-18, with 51 detections.

Compared with the previous season: -78% compared with 2023 (1,512 detections).

results.title: Limitations of this project
results.text:
# What to keep in mind when reading any output

**Fires.** Satellites detect heat anomalies. They do not know that a fire is stubble burning. They miss fires that burn between overpasses, fires under cloud, and small or short burns. A district's detection count is a lower bound. Fire dates are UTC dates that we treat as local days, so some night detections are filed one day early.

**Air quality.** PM2.5 is modelled by CAMS on a coarse grid. It is not measured at street level and it is not CPCB monitor data. It already includes fire emissions as the model sees them.

**Districts.** We use 22 district boundaries. Malerkotla, created in 2021, is not a separate district in our boundary data. Its area is counted in Sangrur.
